headlines.title: New video shows moment hero fires at shooter at Idaho In-and-Out
headlines.description: Police in Idaho are hailing an armed citizen a hero for distracting a gunman who opened fire outside an In-and-Out in Twin Falls, helping save lives. Officials say three people were killed and seven others were injured in the shooting. NBC News’ Dana Griffin reports from the scene.

headlines.title: Rep. Miller vows to remain in reelection race amid abuse allegations
headlines.description: Congressman Max Miller (R-Ohio) is doubling down on his reelection bid, defending himself from claims of domestic violence and child abuse by his ex-wife. Miller said he would not leave the race as his ex-father-in-law Senator Bernie Moreno (R-Ohio) said today that Miller is not fit to serve. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Dangerous wildfires in Washington burn thousands of acres
headlines.description: Thousands of people have been forced to evacuate in Washington where fires have burned more than 250,000 acres. From the air to the ground, firefighters are battling the blaze. In Greece, fire officials say two people died after firefighting helicopters collided. NBC News’ Camila Bernal has the latest.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: President Donald Trump agreed to pause attacks on Iran on Saturday, citing “perimeters of a deal” that would end Tehran’s “nuclear threat” and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Fragile ceasefire between U.S. and Iran
headlines.description: President Trump says he will order American forces to hold off on attacks against Iran as a potential deal takes shape. A deal would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons has the story.

headlines.title: Ariana Grande to step back from public life following scrutiny of her health
headlines.description: The singer and actor, who is on tour, will no longer star in the London revival of “Sunday in the Park With George,” which is set to open in summer 2027.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
